To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

phase distortions of a probe beam during pulsed bleaching are due to the increase in density of the gas medium as a result of the explosive evaporation of liquid particles, the lifetime of this process is determined by the duration of the bleaching pulse and is equal to the lifetime of the phase distortion of the probe beam, and the thermal losses during complete bleaching of an aerosol are less than the heat required for complete evaporation of the drops.
the laser pulse is focused during the bleaching process due to the increase in the gas temperature and density.
the refractive index of a fog is a function of the laser radiation power and the time of irradiation and that the phase distortions are a result of the change of the refractive indices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of phase distortion of laser radiation in the case of the bleaching of an aerosol.
the development of an optical method of determining the parameters of a fog and the development of a pulsed method of bleaching a fog in order to increase the range of laser radiation.
the effect of pulsed laser radiation on the refractive index in a fog and the possibility of using the effect for remote diagnostics of a fog.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the phase distortions are due to the change in the gas density resulting from explosive evaporation of droplets.
the laser radiation is capable of producing phase distortions of a probe beam in the case of bleaching a small-volume fog.
the laser radiation is not focused in the fog volume, but is defocused.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the phase distortions in bleaching are caused by the focusing effect due to explosive evaporation of drops.
the phase distortions of laser radiation are determined not only by the density of the gas but also by the distribution of the density of the particles and the distribution of the gas density.
the effect of focusing the radiation on the bleaching of a volume of fog is not significant and that the effect of the refractive indices on the phase distortion of the radiation is significant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the phase distortions of the radiation are caused by a change in the gas temperature and pressure and by the formation of a gas flow.
phase distortions of the laser beam can be used for diagnostics of the bleaching process.
it is possible to use pulsed CO2-laser radiation for bleaching of small volumes of fog and to control the optical properties of the medium.
